pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular, sub-polygonal geometries with smooth pixel gradients and low edge definition due to high image blur. The spatial area of patches varies, appearing larger and more spaced in the upper-left and becoming smaller and more densely clustered toward the lower-right.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous mesh-like topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly 3-way intersections. The pixel thickness of these pathways is narrow and relatively uniform, though structural details are significantly degraded by low resolution.
